author: jay-tau
method: Best legal route per case from credited public parents and the selected refinements.
selection: Lowest checker-recomputed delay, then shortest complete measured wall time; each run starts from a pinned public seed.
hardware: AMD Ryzen 9 8945HS (16 logical CPUs), 15632572 KiB RAM
runtime_scope: One complete measured run per case, from reading the instance and pinned public warm start through refinement, validation and output/metadata writing. Native routing uses one CPU thread; the batch runs up to four cases concurrently on Linux 7.2.9-2-cachyos. Compilation is completed before timing. Upstream public-route generation time is unknown and excluded; no hardware-normalized speed claim is made.

provenance.method: exact A* and bounded group refinement

upstream_attribution.author: kesudh
upstream_attribution.method: Exact shortest-path-tree warm refinement of published routes. Radix/A* trees with feasible per-sink bounds, neutral and group reroutes, preserved-route and displacement-chain repair, bounded excursions, and a multi-worker CPU search portfolio; the opt-in chain-fast modes specialize congestion pricing. Two-parent minimum-cut crossover follows the coordinated_refinement line of work by jay-tau (PR #24). Bounded conflict-based search over static vertex-disjoint multi-sink trees is an adaptation of Sharon et al. (see algorithm_references). This entry's own GPU kernels are audited prototypes and did not generate these routes.
